customManagers.description: The pinned platform dependency (config-base pattern, ticket mo-10, ADR-0001/ADR-0002). Renovate's native flux manager tracks a GitRepository's tag OR commit exclusively and cannot maintain the {tag, commit} pair ADR-0001 requires; this customManager (git-refs datasource) does both together. A bump here is a reviewed PR that also re-renders every quote against the new platform.

packageRules.description: No live semver ranges anywhere (ADR-0002): every match above is pinned exact.
